entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Whoa... So many people![n]There's tons of foreigners[n]here too!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: It's like a festival![n]Do you think it's like[n]this every day?
entries.uk: Прямо як на фестивалі![n]Думаєш, тут щодня[n]отак?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: What're we gonna do here,[n][lName]-san?[n]I'm not interested in temples...
entries.uk: А що ми тут робитимемо,[n][lName]-сан?[n]Мені храми нецікаві...

entries.en: It's nice once in a while.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Huh? Really!?[n]I thought we were going[n]to the temple.
entries.uk: Га? Справді!?[n]Я думав, ми йдемо[n]до храму.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Ooh, do you smell that?[n]Something smells good!

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I'm actually a bit hungry.[n]Hey, can we walk around[n]and eat some food...?
entries.uk: Я, взагалі-то, трохи зголоднів.[n]Слухай, а можна погуляти[n]й чогось поїсти...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: W-Wait, that's it...?[n]Well, there are[n]tons of people here.
entries.uk: З-Зачекай, і все...?[n]Ну, людей тут[n]і справді купа.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey, I smell something good...[n]Can we go over there[n]and check it out...?
entries.uk: Слухай, чимось смачним пахне...[n]Може, сходимо туди[n]й глянемо...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Haha... You figured it out, right?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I haven't been able to eat[n]lunch at school lately,[n]which sucks...
entries.uk: Останнім часом я не можу[n]пообідати в школі,[n]і це відстій...

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: You're really nice, [n][lName]-san.[n]Thanks for bringing me here.
entries.uk: Ти дуже добрий,[n][lName]-сан.[n]Дякую, що привів мене сюди.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Hey, what should we eat first?[n]Ningyo-yaki? Dango?
